purpose: Refresh the complete model/capability benchmark evidence daily while preserving one dedicated benchmark workflow.
freshness: A successful scheduled run records a new verification timestamp. A failed or blocked run does not overwrite the last known evidence with a pass.
notification_policy: Surface meaningful failures, regressions, stale evidence, newly closed gaps, and owner-action blockers; avoid success-noise notifications.
cost_policy: Do not silently initiate paid model/API calls.
mastery_policy: Daily refresh measures current evidence; it does not itself establish mastery without passing benchmark gates.
